mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing clear skies and 67 degrees down at City Hall, with the moon currently in its third quarter phase.

In city news, the engineering department continues to track project reports with AECOM, while the Senior Center is inviting residents to sign up for free tri-shaw bike rides to enjoy our beautiful local trails.
There is plenty to do, with live music at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee both happening today, and the Dane County Farmers Market taking place tomorrow.
In our weekly police report, on July 31, an officer conducted a traffic stop that led to an O W I arrest for a driver who was operating on a flat tire.
Today's flavor of the day is the fan-favorite Really Reese's. Culver's is currently closed but will be ready to serve you starting at 10 AM.
